name: Hentenna
description: The Hentenna is a rectangular wire antenna originally developed in Japan. It offers strong horizontal polarization, moderate gain, and a distinctive rectangular shape that provides a clean, predictable radiation pattern.
modelingNotes: Height and width determine resonant frequency and pattern shape.
Feedpoint offset controls impedance and matching behavior.
Horizontal polarization is typical when mounted vertically.
End effects shorten the required physical dimensions.
Current distribution is modeled along the full rectangular loop.
Mounting height influences takeoff angle and gain.
